metadata.title: Dwarf Galaxy Planes: the discovery of symmetric structures in the Local Group

notes: The paper discusses a hypervelocity-star over-density in the Milky Way halo and the general possibility that hypervelocity stars are unbound (e.g., T:p26-b3), but it does not identify or analyze any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate and supplies no individual stellar identifiers. The named objects are Local Group galaxies and satellites, not stars.
